snippet_primary: "Update 24/11/2025: Today I received an email from Etsy to raise a Case for the order #3863799705 however following the link in the email or by opening the order on the web site I am unable to open a Case. When I press the open Case button it redirects me to the Order page and if I press the help with the order page it redirects me back to the Open Case page. It is impossible. In the meantime I have raised a case with Paypal."
subject_exact: Trustpilot UK reviewer (November 2025) reports Etsy dispute UI is broken: 'Open Case' button and 'Help with Order' page redirect to each other in an infinite loop, making it impossible to file a case; buyer escalated to PayPal instead
local_qualifiers: 'Open Case' button redirects to Order page; 'Help with Order' redirects back — infinite loop
buyer unable to file Etsy case; escalated to PayPal
